name: Irritation
overview: Scripture teaches that irritation and anger can be stirred up by harsh words, but a gentle response can turn away wrath, emphasizing the importance of wise and godly communication (Proverbs 15:1). Trusting in the Lord and handling matters with understanding leads to happiness and good outcomes (Proverbs 16:20). The believer is called to walk away from ungodly influences that provoke scorn and irritation (Psalms 1:1), resting in the care of the Lord as their shepherd (Psalms 23:1), and responding with praise to God’s power and holiness (Psalms 150:1). Christ’s authority to bind and loose on earth and in heaven (Matthew 16:19) assures believers of divine support in overcoming irritations through godly wisdom and spiritual authority.
